process:fdu-device-submit.description: Used when the Agent already has device protocol JSON and needs to create a device task through the FDU device API. Device task creation requires explicit user confirmation, starting execution requires an additional explicit user request, and read-only monitoring may follow after the task exists.
process:fdu-device-submit.name: FDU device task creation

process:fdu-experiment-to-device-task.description: Default end-to-end Agent process from user experiment target to confirmed FDU device task creation, with optional read-only monitoring after the task exists. It guides skill selection, data artifacts, user checkpoints, and safety rules.
process:fdu-experiment-to-device-task.name: FDU experiment target to device task

process:fdu-plan-generation.description: Used to generate recommended conditions, reagent amounts, numbered steps, and a Chinese experiment plan from a user experiment target or reaction space.
process:fdu-plan-generation.name: FDU experiment plan generation

process:fdu-risk-review.description: Cross-cutting guard process that checks reaction feasibility, safety risk, device capability, and action boundaries after recommendation, amount calculation, and numbered step generation produce planning artifacts, before user confirmation.
process:fdu-risk-review.name: FDU risk review

process:fdu-protocol-orchestration.description: Used to convert verified and resource-filled step JSON into device-executable protocol JSON.
process:fdu-protocol-orchestration.name: FDU protocol orchestration

process:fdu-resource-verify.description: Used to refresh resource snapshots, verify required resources in step JSON, and backfill real resource information into step JSON.
process:fdu-resource-verify.name: FDU resource verification and backfill
